title: Youth here has End
html_source:
Perhaps Stephen’s youth here has an end. Perhaps it is only Bloom’s wish for Stephen. The lyrics include: “My young life has an end/ My joy and sorrow as well/… My life can no longer stand firm./ It is very weak and must perish.

Stephen’s life has been weak and perhaps is likely to perish, able to stand firm no longer.
